decisions.reason: As an adjustable cardboard quarter-pallet display, it remains close to the firm's core POS display competence and still supports a customized one-stop offer despite weaker recent visibility.
The pegboard-back cardboard display is still a useful core variant for retail display projects and fits the firm's established production and service model well.

This quarter-pallet format overlaps strongly with other cardboard display options, and with the firm keeping a narrow portfolio its resources are better shifted to more differentiated core products or new developments.
The wooden display pallet is less central to a paper-based display manufacturer and is the weakest fit with the firm's focused, innovation-led cardboard POS business.
